notes.subject: מקומה
notes.rationale: literal 'her/its place' (Nineveh's); BSB substitutes 'Nineveh', most versions keep 'the place thereof'

notes.subject: ירדף חשך
notes.rationale: word order allows 'darkness shall pursue his enemies' (KJV/JPS) or 'he will pursue his enemies into darkness' (ASV/BSV); Hebrew literally 'and his enemies he will pursue — darkness'

notes.subject: ובשטף
notes.rationale: form with prefixed ב found only here; the sweeping-flood image is the verse's engine

translation: تے اِک لنگھدے ہوئے سیلاب نال اوہ اوہدی تھاں دا پورا انت کرےگا، تے ہنیرا اوہدے ویریاں دا پچھا کریگا۔
